summon_problem.problem: summon needs cwd, model, effort, context: pick each for this task, there are no defaults. cwd: the project folder (~ only for home tasks). model: opus for real work, sonnet for routine jobs, haiku for quick lookups. effort: reasoning effort, picked per task: low (or the haiku model) for lookups; medium for mockups, CSS and config; high for research, kernels and risky or delicate work; xhigh or max only for escalations or tasks seimei judges very important, never for long iterative work. context: where it compacts: 256k or 400k for most tasks; 1m only when the task really needs it.
